key.name: display-mode
key.summary: What to render in the panel button
key.description: One of: percent (number only), icon (battery glyph only), both (icon + number), none (hidden).

key.name: show-mouse-glyph
key.summary: Show the symbolic mouse glyph next to the battery indicator

key.name: tint-mouse-glyph
key.summary: Color the mouse glyph using the active battery-level color

key.name: threshold-critical
key.description: Battery percentage at or below this triggers the critical color and one-shot notification.

key.name: threshold-low
key.description: Battery percentage at or below this (but above threshold-critical) triggers the low color.

key.name: apply-color-to-text
key.summary: Tint the percentage text with the band color

key.name: panel-target
key.description: auto = Dash-to-Panel when present else top bar; topbar = GNOME top bar only; dtp = Dash-to-Panel only; both = render on both panels.

key.name: position-index
key.summary: Order within the panel section (0 = leftmost)

key.name: click-behavior
key.description: popup = call org.oxidemx.Daemon.ShowPopup; settings = spawn oxidemx-settings; none = no action.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Used when the DeviceStateChanged signal stream stalls. 5-120 second range; lower is snappier but heavier on the daemon.
